voice.name: ash
voice.instructions: Warm, confident product-launch narrator. Calm and clear, slightly upbeat, natural pacing, short pauses at full stops. Not salesy.

shots.name: hook
shots.vo: Forty tabs. Six PDFs. And you still don't get the paper.

shots.name: find
shots.caption: Any paper. *One* search box.
shots.vo: Koios finds any paper, from one search box.

shots.name: open
shots.caption: Saved, opened — as a PDF, or a *book*.
shots.vo: One click saves it to your library, and opens it. Read the PDF, or flip it open like a book.

shots.name: ask
shots.caption: Ask — and land on the *exact passage*.
shots.vo: Stuck on a line? Ask. Every answer points to the exact passage in the paper.

shots.name: explain
shots.caption: Press *E*. The whole paper, explained.
shots.vo: Press E, and the whole paper is explained. Section by section, maths and all.

shots.name: build
shots.caption: Plan it. Write the notebook. *Run it.*
shots.vo: Then plan the implementation, write the notebook, and run it on a GPU in Colab. Without leaving the paper.

shots.name: end
shots.vo: Koios. Read the paper. Then run it.
